s0201.literal: Juyong Pass was piled with stones to strengthen its defenses.
s0201.idiomatic: Juyong Pass was piled with stones to strengthen its defenses.

s0202.literal: On dinghai day the Liaodong army reached the capital; Yan Temür led troops to resist them and ordered ward headmen in the capital to summon able-bodied men and artisans totaling ten thousand, to serve together with soldiers in garrisoning and defending the walls, each receiving three ingots of notes and three dou of grain monthly.
s0202.idiomatic: On dinghai day the Liaodong army reached the capital; Yan Temür led troops to resist them and ordered ward headmen in the capital to summon able-bodied men and artisans totaling 10,000, to serve together with soldiers in garrisoning and defending the walls, each receiving 3 ingots of notes and 3 dou of grain monthly.

s0203.literal: Under Jining and Jinning routes: Yanmen Pass in Da Prefecture, Yangwu Pass in Guo Prefecture, Tianjian and Piku passes in Lan Prefecture, Zaidi, Tianqiao, and Baiyang passes in Baode Prefecture, Wubao Pass in Shi Prefecture, Xiangyang Pass in Fen Prefecture, Wumen Pass in Xi Prefecture, Matou and Qinwangling passes in Ji Prefecture, and Yindi Pass in Lingshi County — all were ordered to dig trenches and pile stones to strengthen defenses, and able-bodied men were conscripted to garrison them.
s0203.idiomatic: Under Jining and Jinning routes: Yanmen Pass in Da Prefecture, Yangwu Pass in Guo Prefecture, Tianjian and Piku passes in Lan Prefecture, Zaidi, Tianqiao, and Baiyang passes in Baode Prefecture, Wubao Pass in Shi Prefecture, Xiangyang Pass in Fen Prefecture, Wumen Pass in Xi Prefecture, Matou and Qinwangling passes in Ji Prefecture, and Yindi Pass in Lingshi County — all were ordered to dig trenches and pile stones to strengthen defenses, and able-bodied men were conscripted to garrison them.

s0204.literal: On wuzi day Shangdu princes Hulatai and others entered Zijing Pass; officers and troops all scattered in rout; mobile privy council officials Buyan and Ordoman, and commander Yesu Taier led troops to their relief.
s0204.idiomatic: On wuzi day Shangdu princes Hulatai and others entered Zijing Pass; officers and troops all scattered in rout; mobile privy council officials Buyan and Ordoman, and commander Yesu Taier led troops to their relief.

s0205.literal: Shaanxi branch censorate censor-in-chief Yesi Temür led troops across the river from Daqing Pass, captured the officials of Hezhong Prefecture, and killed them.
s0205.idiomatic: Shaanxi branch censorate censor-in-chief Yesi Temür led troops across the river from Daqing Pass, captured the officials of Hezhong Prefecture, and killed them.

s0206.literal: Wanhu Cheli Temür's army scattered in rout and fled; Henan surveillance vice commissioner Wan Jialu said: "Cheli Temür as a great general maintained lax discipline and fled at the sight of the enemy — he should receive severe punishment as encouragement and warning.
s0206.idiomatic: Wanhu Cheli Temür's army scattered in rout and fled; Henan surveillance vice commissioner Wan Jialu said: "Cheli Temür as a great general maintained lax discipline and fled at the sight of the enemy — he should receive severe punishment as encouragement and warning.

s0208.literal: When Hedong learned Yesi Temür's army had arrived, officials all abandoned their cities and fled; Yesi Temür replaced them all with his partisans.
s0208.idiomatic: When Hedong learned Yesi Temür's army had arrived, officials all abandoned their cities and fled; Yesi Temür replaced them all with his partisans.

s0209.literal: Ye'erjini, left chancellor of Yunnan Branch Secretariat, was summoned but did not come.
s0209.idiomatic: Ye'erjini, left chancellor of Yunnan Branch Secretariat, was summoned but did not come.

s0210.literal: Former left chancellor Sanbaonu was executed for crime; his two sons Shangdu and Qala Badur served as attendants — an order restored their confiscated family property and commission edicts.
s0210.idiomatic: Former left chancellor Sanbaonu was executed for crime; his two sons Shangdu and Qala Badur served as attendants — an order restored their confiscated family property and commission edicts.

s0211.literal: Tenth month, on jichou new moon, western monks were ordered to perform Buddhist rites.
s0211.idiomatic: Tenth month, on jichou new moon, western monks were ordered to perform Buddhist rites.

s0212.literal: Yan Temür led troops to Tong Prefecture, attacked and defeated the Liaodong army, which all crossed the Lu River and fled.
s0212.idiomatic: Yan Temür led troops to Tong Prefecture, attacked and defeated the Liaodong army, which all crossed the Lu River and fled.

s0213.literal: Totuo Temür and others were dispatched with four thousand troops to relieve Zijing Pass from the west.
s0213.idiomatic: Totuo Temür and others were dispatched with 4,000 troops to relieve Zijing Pass from the west.

s0214.literal: Ten thousand troops from Jiang-Zhe were mobilized to defend Tong Pass from the west.
s0214.idiomatic: 10,000 troops from Jiang-Zhe were mobilized to defend Tong Pass from the west.

s0215.literal: Routed soldiers from Zijing Pass fled south to Baoding and there plundered wantonly; associate route official Alisha and former grand councillor Zhang Gui's son Zhang Jingwu, wanhu of Wuchang, and others led the people with clubs and killed several hundred.
s0215.idiomatic: Routed soldiers from Zijing Pass fled south to Baoding and there plundered wantonly; associate route official Alisha and former grand councillor Zhang Gui's son Zhang Jingwu, wanhu of Wuchang, and others led the people with clubs and killed several hundred.

s0216.literal: Henan Branch Secretariat mobilized troops to garrison Hulao Pass.
s0216.idiomatic: Henan Branch Secretariat mobilized troops to garrison Hulao Pass.

s0217.literal: On gengyin day our army and the Liaodong army drew up on opposite banks of the Lu River; the Liaodong army fled by night, and our army crossed and attacked them.
s0217.idiomatic: On gengyin day our army and the Liaodong army drew up on opposite banks of the Lu River; the Liaodong army fled by night, and our army crossed and attacked them.

s0218.literal: On xinmao day ritual officials said: "At the beginning of accession, sacrifices should be announced at the suburban altars and the altars of soil and grain; for seasonal offerings the rites should be changed to the second month of each season.
s0218.idiomatic: On xinmao day ritual officials said: "At the beginning of accession, sacrifices should be announced at the suburban altars and the altars of soil and grain; for seasonal offerings the rites should be changed to the second month of each season.

s0220.literal: Zijing Pass troops pressed toward Zhuo Prefecture; associate prefect Jiaohua mobilized able-bodied men to resist.
s0220.idiomatic: Zijing Pass troops pressed toward Zhuo Prefecture; associate prefect Jiaohua mobilized able-bodied men to resist.

s0221.literal: On renchen day Yesianier arrived at Baoding with troops, killed Alisha and others and the five brothers of the Zhang Jingwu family, and seized their family property.
s0221.idiomatic: On renchen day Yesianier arrived at Baoding with troops, killed Alisha and others and the five brothers of the Zhang Jingwu family, and seized their family property.

s0222.literal: Doresh lent forty thousand ingots of notes to his affinal relative, vice salt transport commissioner of Changlu Salt Transport Office Yilimadan, to buy salt for profit in the capital; an edict ordered recovery and investigation.
s0222.idiomatic: Doresh lent 40,000 ingots of notes to his affinal relative, vice salt transport commissioner of Changlu Salt Transport Office Yilimadan, to buy salt for profit in the capital; an edict ordered recovery and investigation.

s0223.literal: On guisi day the four chief steward offices of Shoufu, Huifu, Longxi, and Chongxiang were established to maintain the spirit halls of the ancestral emperors, all at rank 3a and subordinate to the Office of Grand Blessings.
s0223.idiomatic: On guisi day the four chief steward offices of Shoufu, Huifu, Longxi, and Chongxiang were established to maintain the spirit halls of the ancestral emperors, all at rank 3a and subordinate to the Office of Grand Blessings.

s0224.literal: Hulatai's roaming troops pressed toward the southern city; each household in the capital was ordered to furnish one able-bodied man with weapons to join soldiers on the walls, and at each gate jars of water were placed as fire precautions.
s0224.idiomatic: Hulatai's roaming troops pressed toward the southern city; each household in the capital was ordered to furnish one able-bodied man with weapons to join soldiers on the walls, and at each gate jars of water were placed as fire precautions.

s0225.literal: Yan Temür, Prince of Yangzhuo Wang Taiping, Prince of Guo Duoluotai and others fought at Zaolin in Tanzizishan; Tangqishi fell in battle and killed Taiping; the dead covered the fields; the remainder all fled by night; Sadun was sent in pursuit but did not overtake them.
s0225.idiomatic: Yan Temür, Prince of Yangzhuo Wang Taiping, Prince of Guo Duoluotai and others fought at Zaolin in Tanzizishan; Tangqishi fell in battle and killed Taiping; the dead covered the fields; the remainder all fled by night; Sadun was sent in pursuit but did not overtake them.

s0226.literal: On jiawu day the relevant offices were ordered to purchase one thousand horses to grant to soldiers setting out on campaign.
s0226.idiomatic: On jiawu day the relevant offices were ordered to purchase 1,000 horses to grant to soldiers setting out on campaign.

s0227.literal: Totuo Temür, Zhangji, and Yesianier jointly attacked the enemy south of Liangxiang, fighting successively to the Lugou Bridge; Hulatai was wounded and encamped on the bridge for the night.
s0227.idiomatic: Totuo Temür, Zhangji, and Yesianier jointly attacked the enemy south of Liangxiang, fighting successively to the Lugou Bridge; Hulatai was wounded and encamped on the bridge for the night.

s0228.literal: On yiwei day Yan Temür led his army west along the northern hills toward Liangxiang; generals Shi and others fought Hulatai, Alatemür and others at the Lugou Bridge, proclaiming that Yan Temür's main army had arrived — the enemy troops all fled.
s0228.idiomatic: On yiwei day Yan Temür led his army west along the northern hills toward Liangxiang; generals Shi and others fought Hulatai, Alatemür and others at the Lugou Bridge, proclaiming that Yan Temür's main army had arrived — the enemy troops all fled.

s0229.literal: An envoy promulgating an edict at Gansu, upon reaching Shaanxi, had the edict defaced by branch secretariat and branch censorate officials, the envoy shackled and sent to Shangdu.
s0229.idiomatic: An envoy promulgating an edict at Gansu, upon reaching Shaanxi, had the edict defaced by branch secretariat and branch censorate officials, the envoy shackled and sent to Shangdu.

s0230.literal: Prince of Xiangning Bala Siri led troops into Jining, killing and plundering officials and people.
s0230.idiomatic: Prince of Xiangning Bala Siri led troops into Jining, killing and plundering officials and people.

s0231.literal: At the time garrison at the Taihang passes was all deficient; Jining Route reported emergency; an edict directed wanhu Heshang to lead troops through Guyuan Pass to their relief.
s0231.idiomatic: At the time garrison at the Taihang passes was all deficient; Jining Route reported emergency; an edict directed wanhu Heshang to lead troops through Guyuan Pass to their relief.

s0232.literal: Jining Route officials recruited civilian levies to meet the enemy; Heshang's troops formed the rear guard and killed and captured many.
s0232.idiomatic: Jining Route officials recruited civilian levies to meet the enemy; Heshang's troops formed the rear guard and killed and captured many.

s0233.literal: When Shangdu troops arrived in force, Heshang withdrew to hold Guyuan Pass; Jining was thereupon overrun.
s0233.idiomatic: When Shangdu troops arrived in force, Heshang withdrew to hold Guyuan Pass; Jining was thereupon overrun.

s0234.literal: On bingshen day Yan Temür entered court; a banquet was granted at Xingsheng Hall.
s0234.idiomatic: On bingshen day Yan Temür entered court; a banquet was granted at Xingsheng Hall.

s0235.literal: Relief was granted to families in Tong Prefecture that had suffered warfare.
s0235.idiomatic: Relief was granted to families in Tong Prefecture that had suffered warfare.

s0236.literal: Susu and others were ordered to oversee fiscal forage and grain.
s0236.idiomatic: Susu and others were ordered to oversee fiscal forage and grain.

s0237.literal: Central secretariat officials said: "Shangdu princes and great ministers, heedless of the ancestral laws, deceived by the wicked minister Doresh, rashly brought troops to violate the capital region.
s0237.idiomatic: Central secretariat officials said: "Shangdu princes and great ministers, heedless of the ancestral laws, deceived by the wicked minister Doresh, rashly brought troops to violate the capital region.

s0238.literal: Relying on Your Majesty's great fortune, Wang Chan was thus routed; princes Boraltemür and the active ministers Mongol Dash, Yash Temür and others were captured alive; having already been duly executed according to law, their heads should be transmitted to the four directions to show the multitude.
s0238.idiomatic: Relying on Your Majesty's great fortune, Wang Chan was thus routed; princes Boraltemür and the active ministers Mongol Dash, Yash Temür and others were captured alive; having already been duly executed according to law, their heads should be transmitted to the four directions to show the multitude.

s0240.literal: On dingyou day ten men from Jianshan County who had once guided Wang Chan were punished — the four ringleaders were executed, the rest flogged one hundred seven strokes, their family property registered for confiscation, and wives and children distributed as rewards to garrison soldiers at the passes.
s0240.idiomatic: On dingyou day 10 men from Jianshan County who had once guided Wang Chan were punished — the 4 ringleaders were executed, the rest flogged 107 strokes, their family property registered for confiscation, and wives and children distributed as rewards to garrison soldiers at the passes.

s0241.literal: On wuxu day Huguang Branch Secretariat grand councillor Qizhu was ordered to mobilize troops to garrison Gui and Xia; left vice chancellor Biexue was to garrison Bafan to resist Sichuan troops.
s0241.idiomatic: On wuxu day Huguang Branch Secretariat grand councillor Qizhu was ordered to mobilize troops to garrison Gui and Xia; left vice chancellor Biexue was to garrison Bafan to resist Sichuan troops.

s0242.literal: Generals pursued Alatemür and others to Zijing Pass, captured them, sent them to the capital — all were displayed and executed in the marketplace.
s0242.idiomatic: Generals pursued Alatemür and others to Zijing Pass, captured them, sent them to the capital — all were displayed and executed in the marketplace.

s0243.literal: On jihai day the Emperor visited the Dasheng Shou Wan'an Temple and paid respects at the spirit halls of Shizu and Yuzong.
s0243.idiomatic: On jihai day the Emperor visited the Dasheng Shou Wan'an Temple and paid respects at the spirit halls of Shizu and Yuzong.

s0244.literal: Yan Temür was granted the Prince of Taiping's golden seal and an imperial commission edict, and also granted a jade dish, dragon robes, pearl robes, a pearl, a golden belt, and one each of eastern white gyrfalcon and eastern blue gyrfalcon.
s0244.idiomatic: Yan Temür was granted the Prince of Taiping's golden seal and an imperial commission edict, and also granted a jade dish, dragon robes, pearl robes, a pearl, a golden belt, and one each of eastern white gyrfalcon and eastern blue gyrfalcon.

s0245.literal: Henan Branch Secretariat and Mobile Privy Council were both permitted to act at discretion.
s0245.idiomatic: Henan Branch Secretariat and Mobile Privy Council were both permitted to act at discretion.

s0246.literal: Tumen Dayar's army again entered Gubeikou; Yan Temür led troops to resist; a great battle was fought south of Tan Prefecture; they were defeated; his wanhu surrendered with ten thousand troops; Tumen Dayar thereupon fled back to Liaodong.
s0246.idiomatic: Tumen Dayar's army again entered Gubeikou; Yan Temür led troops to resist; a great battle was fought south of Tan Prefecture; they were defeated; his wanhu surrendered with 10,000 troops; Tumen Dayar thereupon fled back to Liaodong.

s0247.literal: An envoy promulgating an edict at Shaanxi — branch secretariat and branch censorate officials burned the edict, imprisoned the envoy, and reported to Shangdu.
s0247.idiomatic: An envoy promulgating an edict at Shaanxi — branch secretariat and branch censorate officials burned the edict, imprisoned the envoy, and reported to Shangdu.

s0248.literal: On gengzi day Liang Prince Wang Chan's residence was granted to Prince Temür Buqa.
s0248.idiomatic: On gengzi day Liang Prince Wang Chan's residence was granted to Prince Temür Buqa.

s0249.literal: Court ministers said: "Baoding wanhu Zhang Chang — now that his uncles Jingwu and others have been executed, the troops he commands should be dismissed and his golden tiger tally confiscated.
s0249.idiomatic: Court ministers said: "Baoding wanhu Zhang Chang — now that his uncles Jingwu and others have been executed, the troops he commands should be dismissed and his golden tiger tally confiscated.

s0251.literal: On xinchou day associate privy council administrator Totuo Temür and transmission commissioner Yebulun were both made privy council administrators; associate censor-in-chief Yiliechi was made censor-in-chief.
s0251.idiomatic: On xinchou day associate privy council administrator Totuo Temür and transmission commissioner Yebulun were both made privy council administrators; associate censor-in-chief Yiliechi was made censor-in-chief.

s0252.literal: Family property of Barqachar and Duodu was restored.
s0252.idiomatic: Family property of Barqachar and Duodu was restored.

s0253.literal: Prince of Qi Yolqi Temür, Eastern Route Mongol marshal Buqa Temür and others besieged Shangdu with troops; Doresh and others presented the imperial seal and surrendered.
s0253.idiomatic: Prince of Qi Yolqi Temür, Eastern Route Mongol marshal Buqa Temür and others besieged Shangdu with troops; Doresh and others presented the imperial seal and surrendered.

s0254.literal: Liang Prince Wang Chan fled; Liaoning Prince Tuotuo was killed by Prince of Qi Yolqi Temür; the seals of Shangdu princes were thereupon collected.
s0254.idiomatic: Liang Prince Wang Chan fled; Liaoning Prince Tuotuo was killed by Prince of Qi Yolqi Temür; the seals of Shangdu princes were thereupon collected.

s0255.literal: On renyin day imperial provision commissioner Yesianier was made acting mobile privy council administrator; deputy imperial provision commissioner Zhangji was made deputy mobile privy council administrator; together with privy council administrator Yesu Taier and others they led troops west to attack Tong Pass troops.
s0255.idiomatic: On renyin day imperial provision commissioner Yesianier was made acting mobile privy council administrator; deputy imperial provision commissioner Zhangji was made deputy mobile privy council administrator; together with privy council administrator Yesu Taier and others they led troops west to attack Tong Pass troops.

s0256.literal: Central secretariat officials said: "Yeriya was once dismissed for corruption; he was recently reappointed Imperial Physician — we dare not obey the edict.
s0256.idiomatic: Central secretariat officials said: "Yeriya was once dismissed for corruption; he was recently reappointed Imperial Physician — we dare not obey the edict.

s0257.literal: The Emperor said: "What is past should not be blamed; when the army was raised I already recorded him for employment — let it be done according to my command.
s0257.idiomatic: The Emperor said: "What is past should not be blamed; when the army was raised I already recorded him for employment — let it be done according to my command.

s0258.literal: Zhang Gui's daughter was given in marriage to Yesianier.
s0258.idiomatic: Zhang Gui's daughter was given in marriage to Yesianier.

s0259.literal: On guimao day the wife of the late imperial provision commissioner Shiliemen was granted to Yan Temür.
s0259.idiomatic: On guimao day the wife of the late imperial provision commissioner Shiliemen was granted to Yan Temür.

s0260.literal: Tong Prefecture prefect Zhao Yi, for having been able to resist the enemy, was granted two bolts of silks.
s0260.idiomatic: Tong Prefecture prefect Zhao Yi, for having been able to resist the enemy, was granted 2 bolts of silks.

s0261.literal: Yesi Timür's army reached Jinning; officials of the route all fled.
s0261.idiomatic: Yesi Timür's army reached Jinning; officials of the route all fled.

s0262.literal: On jiachen day darughachis of routes, prefectures, and counties under the Jin residence and Liaoning Prince were all dismissed, placed under detention, and replaced with regular appointees.
s0262.idiomatic: On jiachen day darughachis of routes, prefectures, and counties under the Jin residence and Liaoning Prince were all dismissed, placed under detention, and replaced with regular appointees.

s0263.literal: Huaidong pacification commission was granted silver-character round tally.
s0263.idiomatic: Huaidong pacification commission was granted silver-character round tally.

s0264.literal: Relevant offices were ordered to collect seals, tally tokens, and weapons abandoned by officers and soldiers.
s0264.idiomatic: Relevant offices were ordered to collect seals, tally tokens, and weapons abandoned by officers and soldiers.

s0265.literal: One hundred thousand shi of rice was sold in relief in the capital at fifteen strings of notes per shi.
s0265.idiomatic: 100,000 shi of rice was sold in relief in the capital at 15 strings of notes per shi.

s0266.literal: On bingwu day central secretariat officials said: "When criminals are punished, after registering family property their wives and children are also confiscated — this is not the ancient meaning of not extending punishment to families; hereafter please do not confiscate men's wives and children.
s0266.idiomatic: On bingwu day central secretariat officials said: "When criminals are punished, after registering family property their wives and children are also confiscated — this is not the ancient meaning of not extending punishment to families; hereafter please do not confiscate men's wives and children.

s0268.literal: On dingwei day announcement sacrifices were made at the southern suburban altar.
s0268.idiomatic: On dingwei day announcement sacrifices were made at the southern suburban altar.

s0269.literal: Central secretariat grand councillor Taqaji was made grand minister of agriculture; Qincha was again made central secretariat grand councillor; attendant censor Yulubuhua was made associate censor-in-chief.
s0269.idiomatic: Central secretariat grand councillor Taqaji was made grand minister of agriculture; Qincha was again made central secretariat grand councillor; attendant censor Yulubuhua was made associate censor-in-chief.

s0270.literal: Because fiscal forage and beans were insufficient for current needs, all princes and imperial sons-in-law coming to court had their provisions curtailed; guard officers who already had grain stipends and palace eunuchs and women with annual forage allotments — all were temporarily suspended.
s0270.idiomatic: Because fiscal forage and beans were insufficient for current needs, all princes and imperial sons-in-law coming to court had their provisions curtailed; guard officers who already had grain stipends and palace eunuchs and women with annual forage allotments — all were temporarily suspended.

s0271.literal: Two hundred thousand shi of beans were purchased in prefectures and counties along the Imperial Canal; payment was made from salt duty notes of Hejian and Shandong.
s0271.idiomatic: 200,000 shi of beans were purchased in prefectures and counties along the Imperial Canal; payment was made from salt duty notes of Hejian and Shandong.

s0272.literal: River-defense grain-transport troops were released and sent home.
s0272.idiomatic: River-defense grain-transport troops were released and sent home.

s0273.literal: Shaanxi troops reached Heishi Ford in Gong County and thereupon occupied Hulao; our troops all scattered; stored weapons were all captured.
s0273.idiomatic: Shaanxi troops reached Heishi Ford in Gong County and thereupon occupied Hulao; our troops all scattered; stored weapons were all captured.

s0274.literal: Henan Branch Secretariat reported emergency; an order warned relevant offices to repair walls and strengthen garrison.
s0274.idiomatic: Henan Branch Secretariat reported emergency; an order warned relevant offices to repair walls and strengthen garrison.

s0275.literal: Yunnan Yingshaluo native official Aizan and others came to present tribute goods.
s0275.idiomatic: Yunnan Yingshaluo native official Aizan and others came to present tribute goods.

s0276.literal: On jiyou day Biebuhua was additionally made grand guardian and removed from privy council administrator.
s0276.idiomatic: On jiyou day Biebuhua was additionally made grand guardian and removed from privy council administrator.

s0277.literal: Ministry of Justice bureau director Dadu and former Guangdong associate official Zhang Shirong were ordered to pursue recovery of Ubaidullah's family property.
s0277.idiomatic: Ministry of Justice bureau director Dadu and former Guangdong associate official Zhang Shirong were ordered to pursue recovery of Ubaidullah's family property.

s0279.literal: Shaanxi troops seized Wu Pass; wanhu Yang Kezhong and others' troops scattered in rout.
s0279.idiomatic: Shaanxi troops seized Wu Pass; wanhu Yang Kezhong and others' troops scattered in rout.

s0280.literal: On gengxu day the Emperor presided at Xingsheng Hall; Prince of Qi Yolqi Temür, princes Bes Temür, Arqashiri, Nohaihan, and Eastern Route Mongol marshal Buqa Temür and others presented the imperial seal.
s0280.idiomatic: On gengxu day the Emperor presided at Xingsheng Hall; Prince of Qi Yolqi Temür, princes Bes Temür, Arqashiri, Nohaihan, and Eastern Route Mongol marshal Buqa Temür and others presented the imperial seal.

s0281.literal: Doresh and others were brought to the capital and imprisoned; envoys were dispatched separately with proclamations to branch secretariat and inner prefectures to cease troops and reassure the people.
s0281.idiomatic: Doresh and others were brought to the capital and imprisoned; envoys were dispatched separately with proclamations to branch secretariat and inner prefectures to cease troops and reassure the people.

s0282.literal: The wife, slaves, and fields and houses of eunuch Botemür were granted to Sadun.
s0282.idiomatic: The wife, slaves, and fields and houses of eunuch Botemür were granted to Sadun.

s0283.literal: On xinhai day Yunnan Cheli Route native officials Diaosai and others came to present tribute goods.
s0283.idiomatic: On xinhai day Yunnan Cheli Route native officials Diaosai and others came to present tribute goods.

s0284.literal: An edict: "Henceforth court governance and registration and confiscation of fields and houses for grants — without deliberation with Yan Temür, no person may memorialize or petition.
s0284.idiomatic: An edict: "Henceforth court governance and registration and confiscation of fields and houses for grants — without deliberation with Yan Temür, no person may memorialize or petition.

s0285.literal: The slaves and family property of eunuch Mishamini were granted to Barq.
s0285.idiomatic: The slaves and family property of eunuch Mishamini were granted to Barq.

s0286.literal: On renzi day because Henan, Jiangxi, and Huguang tribute of imperial geese was too frequent, the number was reduced to spare relay stations.
s0286.idiomatic: On renzi day because Henan, Jiangxi, and Huguang tribute of imperial geese was too frequent, the number was reduced to spare relay stations.

s0287.literal: Prince Huosha's residence was granted to Yan Temür's stepmother Princess Chagir.
s0287.idiomatic: Prince Huosha's residence was granted to Yan Temür's stepmother Princess Chagir.

s0288.literal: On guichou day Yan Temür resigned as privy council administrator; his uncle Eastern Route Mongol marshal Buqa Temür was appointed in his place.
s0288.idiomatic: On guichou day Yan Temür resigned as privy council administrator; his uncle Eastern Route Mongol marshal Buqa Temür was appointed in his place.

s0289.literal: Yan Temür requested that thirty persons' fields and houses including Mongol Dash be granted to thirty persons including Cheli Temür — approved.
s0289.idiomatic: Yan Temür requested that 30 persons' fields and houses including Mongol Dash be granted to 30 persons including Cheli Temür — approved.

s0290.literal: Of horses collected from Hebei routes, four hundred were given to the four guard corps' atachi, two hundred to the inner palace atachi, and the remaining two thousand were distributed for pasturing in inner prefectures.
s0290.idiomatic: Of horses collected from Hebei routes, 400 were given to the four guard corps' atachi, 200 to the inner palace atachi, and the remaining 2,000 were distributed for pasturing in inner prefectures.

s0291.literal: Shangdu storehouses' money and grain were audited.
s0291.idiomatic: Shangdu storehouses' money and grain were audited.

s0292.literal: Censorate officials said: "Recently northern troops seized Zijing Pass; government troops scattered and fled and plundered the people of Baoding.
s0292.idiomatic: Censorate officials said: "Recently northern troops seized Zijing Pass; government troops scattered and fled and plundered the people of Baoding.

s0293.literal: This route's officials and the five sons of former grand councillor Zhang Gui, Jingwu, led their people to attack government troops and were killed; Yesianier without awaiting memorial and report rashly killed officials on his own authority and five sons of Zhang.
s0293.idiomatic: This route's officials and the five sons of former grand councillor Zhang Gui, Jingwu, led their people to attack government troops and were killed; Yesianier without awaiting memorial and report rashly killed officials on his own authority and five sons of Zhang.

s0294.literal: Zhang Gui's father and grandfather for three generations were meritorious ministers of the state — even if Zhang Gui's sons had guilt, what guilt had Zhang Gui's wife and daughters!
s0294.idiomatic: Zhang Gui's father and grandfather for three generations were meritorious ministers of the state — even if Zhang Gui's sons had guilt, what guilt had Zhang Gui's wife and daughters!

s0295.literal: Now having registered their family, yet giving his daughter in marriage to Yesianier — this is truly not the state's intent in treating meritorious ministers.
s0295.idiomatic: Now having registered their family, yet giving his daughter in marriage to Yesianier — this is truly not the state's intent in treating meritorious ministers.

s0296.literal: The Emperor said: "What you say is correct.
s0296.idiomatic: The Emperor said: "What you say is correct.

s0297.literal: " The central secretariat was ordered to rectify it.
s0297.idiomatic: " The central secretariat was ordered to rectify it.

s0298.literal: The censorate was ordered to select men to fill surveillance posts in each circuit.
s0298.idiomatic: The censorate was ordered to select men to fill surveillance posts in each circuit.

s0299.literal: Officials were dispatched to grant relief to relay households in Liangxiang, Zhuo Prefecture, Dingxing, and Baoding that had suffered warfare.
s0299.idiomatic: Officials were dispatched to grant relief to relay households in Liangxiang, Zhuo Prefecture, Dingxing, and Baoding that had suffered warfare.

s0300.literal: On jiayin day the Office of Imperial Provision was abolished and the Office of Stored Blessings was established, rank 2a.
s0300.idiomatic: On jiayin day the Office of Imperial Provision was abolished and the Office of Stored Blessings was established, rank 2a.
